n: REV Robotics Education Kit and FTC Class Pack
t: A grades 7 to 12 robotics curriculum built around a REV competition robot kit.
steps: Find the FTC Class Pack on the FIRST website and register.
Buy the REV Control Hub based kit separately.
Ask IT about the software needed for programming.
Review the first unit and its guiding question.
Try one lab before assigning it to students.
